scripts.setup: python3 -m venv engine/.venv && engine/.venv/bin/pip install -e "engine[dev]" && npm install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:app
scripts.test:app: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix app test
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:engine && node scripts/desktop.mjs build
